cover.title: 5 client red flags to *ghost*
cover.sub: Spot them on the first call, before you quote.

slides.title: Vague *scope*
slides.says: "We'll figure out the details as we go."
slides.fix: Send a 1-page brief: what does "done" look like, and what's out of scope?

slides.title: Rush, no *plan*
slides.says: "We need it by Friday. Can you start today?"
slides.fix: Urgent is fine. Unplanned isn't. Brief first, and a rush fee on top.

slides.title: Skips the *contract*
slides.says: "Let's just start and sort the paperwork later."
slides.fix: No signed scope, no start. A one-page agreement takes ten minutes.

slides.title: Price before *scope*
slides.says: "What's your cheapest option?" (before hearing what you do)
slides.fix: Give a range after the scope call, never before it.

slides.title: No *decision-maker*
slides.says: "Looks great, I'll run it by my boss."
slides.fix: Ask who signs off, and get them on the next call before you quote.

slides.label: flags = politely pass
slides.body: One freelancer's simple rule: one flag, ask more questions. Two flags on the first call, walk away.

slides.title: Send this to a *freelancer* friend
slides.sub: Follow @claybyte.in for daily AI + agency tips.

items.caption:
5 client red flags to ghost this Halloween 👻 Save this for your next discovery call.

1. Vague scope: "we'll figure it out as we go" → send a 1-page brief first
2. Rush with no plan: "can you start today?" → brief first, rush fee on top
3. Skips the contract: "paperwork later" → no signed scope, no start
4. Price before scope: "what's your cheapest option?" → give a range after the scope call
5. No decision-maker: "I'll run it by my boss" → get the person who signs off on the next call

One simple rule: one flag, ask more questions. Two on the first call, politely pass.

Send this to a freelancer friend who keeps saying yes to everyone.

items.caption:
Stop refreshing your views. Check 3 things, once, 48 hours after you post.

1. Retention graph: where do people drop off? A big drop in the first seconds = fix the hook.
2. Shares: did anyone send it to a friend?
3. Saves: did anyone keep it for later?

Then change ONE thing in your next post. Not five. One. That's how you actually learn what works.

Send this to the friend who checks their views every 10 minutes.

#contentcreator #instagramtips #creatortips #reelstips #socialmediatips #consistency
